name: Anti-Flash
description: The purpose of this patch is to remove any flashes from the game that could possibly trigger seizures due to photosensitive epilepsy. So far there are three major event-related flash instances that this patch will remove, but in the future I hope to remove any more from spells and other events or what have you, but for now it at least takes care of the major ones.

name: Food Items
description: Changes the classic Final Fantasy items (Potion, Ether...) to that of food-related items, just for the hell of it.

name: Pig's Map
description: This patch is the other half of the 'Imp's Map' patch that changes characters who have Imp/Pig status to the Pig sprite for the area maps as well as the overworld. It was broken up as an optional patch because for the area maps there's a palette issue that still needs figuring out, and because it can potentially take away from the sincerity of events.

name: Remove Splash Screen
description: Removes the 'splash screen' as it's called, which is the very first screen you see when the game fires up. Useful for any folks and/or streamers who do not wish to have the playable characters spoiled by them being on the splash screen, or just to save a second of time/the repeated annoyance of seeing it every time.

name: Skip Intro
description: This patch removes the custom intro at the very beginning of the game if there is no save data present, for any who may be sick of seeing it.
